lines.speaker: Winter (Hiems)
lines.text: Tu-who;

lines.speaker: Winter (Hiems)
lines.text: Tu-whit, to-who--a merry note,

lines.speaker: Winter (Hiems)
lines.text: While greasy Joan doth keel the pot.

lines.speaker: Don Adriano de Armado
lines.text: The words of Mercury are harsh after the songs of Apollo.

lines.speaker: Don Adriano de Armado
lines.text: You that way: we this way.
